features: [Ergonomic design]: Experience comfort with the ZEB-Duke Plus BT headphones, featuring soft, long-lasting earcups for extended listening pleasure.
[Multi-connectivity]: With Bluetooth v5.4 connectivity and AUX compatibility, these headphones offer seamless connectivity options.

[ANC]: The ANC feature (active noise cancellation) cuts traffic rumbling noises around so you can focus solely on the audio, reduces background noise, ensuring clarity of audio for calls and music, even in noisy environments.
[Incredible audio]: Immerse yourself in crystal-clear audio with 40mm drivers on each side, delivering pristine acoustics and powerful bass.
[Low latency gaming]: Enjoy high-speed gaming with the ZEB-Duke Plus headphones, designed to enhance your gaming experience with low latency performance.
